title: Chain of Responsibility
description: Pass requests along a chain of handlers until one handles it.

data.text: The **Chain of Responsibility Pattern** passes requests along a chain of handlers. Each handler decides either to process the request or to pass it to the next handler in the chain.

data.title: Chain of Responsibility
Key Takeaways
points: Multiple objects can handle a request
data.takeaway: Use Chain of Responsibility when multiple objects may handle a request.
